import json,hashlib,pyarrow.parquet as pq
from pathlib import Path
m=json.loads(Path('/source/slice.json').read_text());rows=[];seen=set();sources=[]
for obj in m['objects']:
 if obj['component']!='lidar':continue
 p=Path('/source')/obj['relative_path'];digest=hashlib.file_digest(p.open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest();assert digest==obj['sha256'];sources.append({'context':obj['context'],'sha256':digest})
 columns=['key.segment_context_name','key.frame_timestamp_micros','key.laser_name']+[f'[LiDARComponent].range_image_return{i}.shape' for i in [1,2]]
 for batch in pq.ParquetFile(p).iter_batches(batch_size=64,columns=columns):
  for r in batch.to_pylist():
   for ret in [1,2]:
    shape=r[f'[LiDARComponent].range_image_return{ret}.shape'];key=(r['key.segment_context_name'],r['key.frame_timestamp_micros'],r['key.laser_name'],ret)
    assert key not in seen and key[0]==obj['context'];seen.add(key)
    if shape is not None:assert len(shape)==3 and all(type(x) is int and x>0 for x in shape) and shape[2]==4
    rows.append({'context':key[0],'timestamp':key[1],'laser':key[2],'return':ret,'native_shape':shape})
assert len(sources)==2 and len(rows)==3970
Path('/outputs/shapes.json').write_text(json.dumps({'sources':sources,'rows':rows,'scope':'engineering native metadata only; null shape retained, no inferred grid extent'},indent=2))
print('PASS original grid shape inventory',len(rows),'records',len(sources),'source-pinned scenes')
